name: A Thoughtless Embrace
source:
Samuel, Ann and Oliver used to form a trio of close-knit friends during high school. The three were inseparable, despite their different personalities: Samuel was nerdy, Ann studious, and Oliver flippant. Somehow, they managed to form a close friendship with one another.
After graduation, Samuel and Ann began dating, while Oliver mysteriously fell off the grid. Their relationship evolved slowly and steady... and 5 years later, as working adults, the two of them are now enjoying their lives living together.
One night, Ann decides to walk her boyfriend Samuel to the station, as he's about to leave on a two-nights trip to visit his folks. Alone at their apartment for the first time, Ann begins to fret about their relationships perhaps being close to stagnating, despite how comfortable they both feel.
And on the way back home, who would she meet but her old friend Oliver, who has come back to their hometown after 5 years away. The two old friends decide to catch up, as both Ann and Oliver share with each other what has been going on with their lives. Their banter is friendly, but there is a certain tension that cannot be shaken away...
And as Samuel sits on that train, thinking about his wonderful girlfriend...
...Things at their apartment begin to escalate. A conversation between old friends slowly veering towards intimacy. What could have brought this on? Why is Ann allowing this to happen? Why is she pretending nothing lewd is going on? And why has Oliver returned just now, after 5 whole years?
It all begins with an innocent, thoughtless embrace.
